hops_not_traced: +0x198/+0x1210 (the PCM buffer address) is a runtime allocation or one of the two static buffers at 0x8015af88; no cartridge byte decides it, so the trace stops at its size.
the rate hop: the descriptor takes the caller's argument, and the record's own rate halfword is read by nothing (see unresolved). The values agree for this clip; the hop is not traced.

argument_block.name: flags_and_rate

argument_block.meaning: a starting position, zero for the voice path
argument_block.name: position

argument_block.meaning: zero for the voice path; this is the byte the MORT voice always hands 0

fields.meaning: set by the engine when the record is armed by its start call (FUN_800a597c writes 1) and tested by the per-frame builder; 0 here means the frame is skipped
fields.name: active

fields.meaning: set to 1 on every start beside the zeroing of the word above; no reader found
fields.name: start_flag_b

fields.meaning: zeroed, then bit 0 is set unless the buffer address in the command starts with 0x8; the per-frame builder branches on it to choose which command layout it writes
fields.name: voice_flags

fields.meaning: the resampling ratio in 12-bit fixed point: (rate / _DAT_80147fa4) * 4096, clamped to 0.5 (0x2000). At 16 kHz against a 32 kHz output this is 0x800
fields.name: pitch_word

fields.meaning: the voice's playback position carried as a double, so the fractional part survives between frames: the builder subtracts the integer part and keeps the remainder times 65536
fields.name: position_double

fields.meaning: the integer part of that position, rewritten from it every frame by FUN_800a485c before the command list is built
fields.name: position_integer

fields.meaning: last frame's integer position; FUN_800a485c copies +0x10 into it before advancing, so the pair is the one-frame stride the builder measures
fields.name: position_previous

fields.meaning: the four running gains at stride 2 (0x18, 0x1a, 0x1c, 0x1e - one field of four): every frame the builder scales the matching target by the float at +0x4c, writes the result back here, and carries the difference to the old value as a per-frame step in the command list. So the descriptor holds current and target gains, and the CPU computes both
fields.name: gain_current

fields.meaning: the sample buffer from the command: for a MORT voice, the PCM the synthesis filled
fields.name: pcm_base

fields.meaning: the first of the three length words the command carries; for a MORT voice it is the same capacity as +0x38, which is why the +0x3c loop length comes out zero
fields.name: buffer_end

fields.meaning: the command's second length word; the MORT voice hands 0 here
fields.name: loop_start

fields.meaning: the command's third length word; the MORT voice hands the capacity, the same value as +0x30
fields.name: loop_end

fields.meaning: buffer_end - (loop_start + loop_end), zeroed when it falls below 10: a derived word, not an input, and 0 for every MORT voice because +0x30 and +0x38 agree
fields.name: loop_length

fields.meaning: one of four s16 TARGET gains at stride 2 (0x40, 0x42, 0x44, 0x46). The CPU computes each one itself, through two float tables: a packed word is split into a table index and an 8.8 fraction and interpolated, then stored as gain*32767. Which output channel each of the four feeds is not stated by any MIPS instruction - it is one of the unobservable entries this map lists rather than guesses

fields.meaning: the second target gain (see +0x40)

command.what: FUN_800a924c's arguments, and the two records they land in. This is the CPU's last statement about the voice before the microcode takes it.

fields.meaning: the long-term predictor's period in samples: initialised to 40, and re-latched from the incoming value only while it lies in 40..120 (a value outside is ignored, not clamped)

fields.meaning: two 16-byte banks of eight dequantised coefficients; the reader selects one per call with +0x188, so 0x168 and 0x178 are one field with an index, not two

fields.meaning: one of the bit reader's two run-length cursors: decremented per code and reloaded when it reaches zero, at which point the other cursor is loaded (0x800b53f4's field map, M198)

fields.meaning: the bit reader's second run-length cursor; same reload rule as +0x18a
fields.name: reader_cursor_b

fields.meaning: the transfer routine the reader calls to fill the ring; FUN_800b44f4, which hands the bytes to FUN_800b4818 and posts the queue message
fields.name: dma_callback

fields.meaning: the record's address in the cartridge: the bank base (0x8015af78) plus the per-clip offset's low 24 bits, computed by the caller
fields.name: source_rom

fields.meaning: the PCM destination: 4320 16-bit samples for 16 kHz, either a heap block sized by FUN_800a9420 or one of the two static buffers at 0x8015af88

fields.meaning: that buffer's capacity in 16-bit units, and simultaneously the ring-of-PCM length the engine voice is told: the synthesis wraps at it and the engine drains against it

fields.meaning: blocks the record still declares, seeded from the header's +4 halfword and decremented per synthesised block; zero stops synthesis unless the stream is still fetching

fields.meaning: written from the same header halfword as +0x11a0, in the same few instructions, and read by nothing in the corpus: kept here as an unexplained write rather than explained away

fields.name: record_words_remaining

fields.meaning: the PCM still owed to the engine once the last block is written: set to the capacity, reduced by what the engine pulls, and reaching zero it makes the stream state 4

fields.meaning: the OSMesgQueue the reader blocks on while a chunk is in flight; osCreateMesgQueue is given 0x11ac as the queue and 0x11c4 as the message array, so the 24-byte object ends exactly where the message begins

fields.meaning: the one-message array beside that queue: the transfer routine posts to it and the reader only ever asks whether a message arrived, never what it says, so no instruction reads the value itself
fields.name: dma_message

fields.meaning: the codec's bit position inside the ring, in bits; seeded to 96 so the reader starts after the 12-byte header, and advanced by the synthesis

fields.meaning: the bit cursor rounded down to a 4-byte boundary; the reader's low-water mark, which decides whether another chunk may land in the ring

fields.meaning: bytes fetched from the record so far; it is also the ring window, because the destination is (rom_offset & 0xff8) + 0x1a0, and it is what the tail-chunk test keys off

fields.meaning: the reader's phase: 0 idle, 1 armed (a source and a callback exist), 2 primed (the engine voice is live and the PCM has been consumed once), 3 draining, 4 done. Only 3 accepts pulls from the callback (0x800b4d30:16), so a chunk is never handed over before its PCM exists

fields.meaning: how many 160-sample blocks this pass may synthesise; FUN_800b4a04 copies it into a local and decrements that, so the field itself stays 2 for the stream's life
fields.name: pass_budget

fields.meaning: the slot's own state, and the only thing the allocator scans for: 0 free, 1 started and waiting for the engine, 2 playing, 3 finishing. Written 1 by the starter and 2 by the frame thread when the stream reaches 2

fields.meaning: the first of four parameters the caller passes straight through to the engine voice start; not interpreted anywhere on the MIPS side
fields.name: param_a

fields.meaning: the second passed-through parameter; live-updatable through func_800b3a68
fields.name: param_b

fields.meaning: the third passed-through parameter
fields.name: param_c

fields.meaning: the fourth passed-through parameter: a different byte, same forward-only role
fields.name: param_d

fields.meaning: the first argument the engine voice start receives; it selects which of the engine's handles is allocated (FUN_800aedc0's search key), so it decides what kind of voice this is
fields.name: engine_key

fields.meaning: the sample rate the engine voice is tuned to: it becomes the pitch word by way of /_DAT_80147fa4*4096, and the block rate by way of 160 samples per block. The caller supplies it (16000 by default, 8000 when the bank's flag byte is zero); nothing reads the record's own rate halfword - see unresolved
fields.name: rate

fields.meaning: the engine voice handle FUN_800a924c returned, or -1 while none is live; it is what the stop path passes to FUN_800a942c and what the release path tests before freeing the buffer
fields.name: engine_handle

fields.meaning: the same pointer as +0x198, kept separately for the engine handoff and for the release path: on a freed slot the engine is handed +0x1210, not +0x198

fields.name: pcm_capacity_alloc

fields.meaning: set to 4 when the stream reports done and decremented by the frame thread; the slot is released when it reaches 0, which is how a finished voice survives its own final drain
fields.name: stop_countdown

fields.meaning: PCM units the engine's callback has actually taken, accumulated by the callback itself and zeroed when the voice starts; FUN_800b3ddc divides it by the rate to build the progress the caller sees
fields.name: pcm_units_delivered

fields.meaning: a float duration the frame thread computes once: (blocks_remaining * 160) / rate. It is written, never read in the corpus
fields.name: declared_seconds

fields.meaning: the caller's handle: FUN_800b3640 assigns a fresh id on every start and the control functions find a slot by scanning two entries for it
fields.name: voice_id

chunking.fetch_when: stream_state in {1,2,3} and (rom_offset - ring_consumed) < 0xc01, so at most three chunks are ever outstanding in a 4 KiB ring
chunking.rule: the fetch destination is ring + (rom_offset & 0xff8); the byte count is 0x400, except that once descriptor+0x11a4 (words still declared) falls below 0x101 it becomes 0x11a4<<2, i.e. the record's own tail

ring.contents: the record's bytes, exactly as the cartridge holds them, refilled 0x400 at a time through the DMA callback at descriptor+0x190
ring.correction: +0x1a4 and +0x1a8 are not stream state, though they sit where stream state would expect to be: the ring spans 0x1a0..0x119f, so those two reads are ring bytes 4..11, and they happen exactly once, while rom_offset is still 0 and the first chunk is the record's header. Every actual stream field is at 0x11a0 and above.

layout.evidence: the DMA destination arithmetic, not a field read
layout.meaning: the record's first halfword, 'MO'; never read by the codec, which starts at +0x60
layout.name: magic

layout.meaning: the MORT header's block count, and the only thing the reader takes out of the ring: read as a halfword into descriptor+0x11a0 when rom_offset is still 0
layout.name: header_blocks

layout.evidence: absence, established by scanning every image for the immediate
layout.meaning: the MORT header's sample rate; NO instruction in any unpacked image reads this halfword (every immediate 0x1a6/0x1a7 in the corpus belongs to a stack frame), so the descriptor's rate cannot be traced through it - see unresolved
layout.name: header_rate

layout.meaning: the record's length in 32-bit words, masked to 24 bits into descriptor+0x11a4 and from there into 4-byte tail-chunk arithmetic
layout.name: header_words

overlap.claim: the ring and the post-ring state do not overlap: 0x1a0 + 0x1000 == 0x11a0

rsp_only.name: command_record_semantics
rsp_only.what: what the microcode does with the 0x50-byte per-voice command record, and what each of its words means
rsp_only.why_unobservable: FUN_800a3bf4 writes one record per active voice per frame into the list at 0x80143f50, and no MIPS instruction in the corpus ever reads that list back: its only consumer is the RSP program, so every field's meaning is a property of microcode that is not in the corpus.

rsp_only.name: gain_application
rsp_only.what: how the four target gains at engine+0x40..0x46 are applied per sample, and which output channel each of the four feeds
rsp_only.why_unobservable: the CPU only computes the target gains and the per-frame ramp step (FUN_800a3bf4 divides the difference by 6 and shifts); applying that ramp per sample, and choosing a channel, is the mixer's job and leaves no MIPS trace.

rsp_only.name: resampling
rsp_only.what: how the pitch word at engine+0x04 becomes an interpolated sample stream
rsp_only.why_unobservable: the CPU computes the ratio as (rate/_DAT_80147fa4)*4096 and stops there; the filter, its taps and its rounding live in the ucode, which is not disassembled anywhere in this repository.

rsp_only.name: loop_choice
rsp_only.what: whether the mixer honours buffer_end (+0x30) or loop_end (+0x38) when they differ, and what a non-zero loop_length (+0x3c) would sound like
rsp_only.why_unobservable: the MORT voice sets +0x30 == +0x38 == the capacity and +0x3c == 0, so the distinction is unobservable from the CPU side by construction - the two candidate readings agree on every voice this path starts.

rsp_only.name: output_frames
rsp_only.what: how the 0x800-byte output buffer at 0x80136b50 is filled and how the AI receives it
rsp_only.why_unobservable: the task block names that buffer and its size, and no MIPS instruction in the corpus writes or reads it; the mixer fills it and the handover to the audio interface is outside the corpus.

rsp_only.name: microcode_identity
rsp_only.what: what the 0x1000 bytes the task block points at (0x800b2700) actually are
rsp_only.why_unobservable: the corpus has no MIPS body between 0x800b2694 and 0x800b3640 and no RSP disassembly exists anywhere in this repository, so the bytes are locatable and their behaviour is not - and the declared 0x1000-byte range overruns into FUN_800b3640, so even the extent is a claim this map does not make.

unresolved.question: Does the descriptor's rate come from the MORT header's rate halfword at ring+6?
unresolved.why: no instruction reads ring+6 (scanned by immediate across every unpacked image), and FUN_800b3704 receives the rate as an argument, defaulting to 16000 or 8000 on the bank table's flag byte. For clip 0 the record declares 16000 and the default is 16000, so the numbers agree without a traced hop.
unresolved.would_settle_it: the caller of FUN_800b3704 for clip 0, and what writes the bank table's flag byte at _DAT_8015af7c.

unresolved.question: What reads descriptor+0x11a2?
unresolved.why: it is written twice from the header's block count (+4) and read by nothing in the corpus.
unresolved.would_settle_it: a reader in code outside the corpus, or a demonstration that the write is dead.

unresolved.question: What is _DAT_80147fa4, the divisor in the pitch word?
unresolved.why: the pitch word is (rate / _DAT_80147fa4) * 4096, so every resampling claim needs this number, and it is RAM: written by FUN_800a80c8 from its argument, with no trace in the corpus to the caller that supplies the audio interface's frequency.
unresolved.would_settle_it: the caller of FUN_800a80c8 and the AI frequency it installs.

unresolved.question: What advances the playback position at engine+0x10 for a MORT voice?
unresolved.why: FUN_800a54ec writes +0x08/+0x10/+0x14 from the command, and for this path every one of them is zero; FUN_800a485c then rewrites +0x10 from +0x08's integer part each frame, which stays zero, and FUN_800a3bf4 reads +0x08 to size its per-frame step. No MIPS instruction in the corpus writes a non-zero position to this record, so either the position is irrelevant because the refill callback delivers PCM by the slot's own +0x11d4 counter, or something outside the corpus writes it.
unresolved.would_settle_it: a watchpoint on engine+0x10 during a clip, or code outside the corpus that stores to it.

unresolved.question: What is the 0x800b2700 / 0x1000 pointer-size pair in the audio task block?
unresolved.why: the corpus has no body between 0x800b2694 and 0x800b3640, so the pair looks like a hole in the stage-2 image - but a 0x1000-byte range from 0x800b2700 ends at 0x800b3700 and thus overruns FUN_800b3640 by 0xc0 bytes, so it cannot be a plain extent of that image.
unresolved.would_settle_it: the routine that consumes the task block, or a dump of the block at run time.

unresolved.question: What is the boot pointer the task block at +0x08 receives?
unresolved.why: FUN_800a2e40 assigns the symbol Ghidra renders as `entry` to it, which is the image's own entry point (0x80018a80) and cannot be an RSP boot address; the decompiler has lost which variable that was.
unresolved.would_settle_it: the linker symbol at that store, or a read of the value in a memory dump.
